name: MOS source-follower supply ripple filter
description: A 100 kohm/10 nF network filters the gate of an NMOS pass source follower; a second NMOS biases its output. Both MOS devices, the 10 kohm load and 100 pF output capacitor are explicit. At 3.3 V input, DC output bias and supply-ripple transfer at 1 and 100 kHz are checked. The gate capacitance filters control voltage while the pass device supplies load current, unlike the active feedback shunt regulator. Output is lower by a body-dependent gate-source drop; no reference regulation, dropout, load-step, stress or PVT guarantee is claimed.
